name: ImportBatches
technicalDescription: Since plan r3 stage 2 every pull of Priority's bank statement lines (SyncPriorityBankLines) is one row of kind שורות דפי בנק – Priority: uploadedAt = when it was pulled, dataDate = the load day, rowsRead = lines the source returned, rowsWritten = new lines, status נכתב / נכשל. The receipts screen's ״נמשך מפריוריטי ב-HH:MM״ reads it. Before that: every uploaded file (bank file, open invoices, aging Excel…). Since Iteration 9 a bank file is uploaded on /collections/receipts and read by the nameless reader agent BankFileReader (ReadBankFile): extractionStatus tracks the reading and verification, checkStatus tracks Nina's record-by-record checks, workDay places it on the week strip. status (נקרא/נכתב/נכשל) is kept for older rows and other file kinds; nothing triggers on it any more.

columns.description: When uploaded

columns.name: workDay

columns.name: verifiedAt

columns.name: checkStatus
